comparison.objective: Open a processor socket, key and seat a CPU, then close its shield and lever; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Sub-millimetre keyed placement and interlocked latch sequencing versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, hammering, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: CPU seated flat within tight pose tolerances and socket locked versus four physical notch fractures and contained fragments.
comparison.reason: Both require damage avoidance in robot assembly, but their central mechanisms and terminal states differ.
